Merger   ✅ Ready to Merge

 The diff implements the requested default-model replacement across the Python and TypeScript SDKs, including capability handling and tests. No review discussions remain unresolved.

For reference when reviewing: OpenAI's deprecations page lists `gpt-5-nano` as shutting down on 2026-12-11 and names `gpt-6-luna` as its replacement: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations

`gpt-5.6-luna` (used here) is not on that page's deprecation list either, so both should keep working; just flagging the vendor's listed replacement in case you'd rather match it.
